priority: Preserve literal n input; offer alternate readings only as candidates.

rootCause.inputLayer: The previous nn overlap rewrite turned rennai into れんない. renai stayed れない but had no 恋愛 candidate.
rootCause.fix: Remove live input rewriting. Query up to four n boundary readings off-main, sharing dictionary caches in an independent converter session. Keep exact whole-word results with a small ranking penalty, at most three alternatives. Alternate queries use N_best=3 with prediction disabled; literal prediction is unchanged.

features.horizontalCursor: Single-finger sweep beyond 60 scaled pt enters cursor mode; hide keys until end/cancel.
features.spaceCursor: Stable 350 ms hold, then horizontal and vertical movement; short space retains original behavior.
features.deleteLine: Upward delete gesture commits line prefix deletion on release. Short backspace defers to release; repeat begins after 420 ms.
features.katakana: Canonical katakana is normally reserved at index 3 (index 0 in katakana mode).
features.expandedCandidates: Original candidate strip and divider hidden while expanded; restored on close.

symbols.implementation: UICollectionView reused cells; both an explicit return button and header arrow.

warmDevice.measurement: Same attached UIWindow, one warmup pass plus three measured passes of nihongo/nani/nanim/nanimo/arigat; publication includes label measurement and actual layout.

validation.coverage: No full keyboard grid rescan and no per-emoji UI testing. Targeted gesture lifecycle and existing sticky/alternate/repeat behavior only.

manual.nPriorityFix: User confirmed 符合预期 in another App with system extension.
manual.newFeatures: User reloaded the final Release extension, tried cursor/space/delete gestures, symbol exit and theme switching, and confirmed 都正常.

validation.screenshots: Rendered test images stay in /private/tmp result bundles. No test screenshot is Git tracked; /Artifacts/**/*.png ignored.

limitations: Extension vertical navigation follows explicit newline lines within host context; it cannot see host soft-wrap coordinates. App sandbox can move by rendered lines.
Line-prefix deletion is newline-based and bounded to 64 proxy context chunks; host context availability can limit very long lines.
N reading alternatives are bounded to complete single-word readings; no whole-sentence spelling rewrite.
Additional alternate-reading computation runs off-main and adds conversion cost; publication and preedit remain independent.
Emoji glyph rendering depends on the iOS font; some Unicode 18 entries may be missing. No search/recents yet.
Four preset color themes, no custom image themes.
Automated shared-view tests do not quantify human error rate or prove every third-party host behaves identically.
